source_policy: Use exact-title scholarly discovery, then verify venue and metadata against an official conference, publisher, DOI, or preprint record. Do not promote a search-result venue without primary-source confirmation.
dataset_policy: Record separately the datasets used for self-supervised or backbone pretraining and the datasets used for downstream evaluation.

records.normalized_title: asymmetric masked distillation for pre training small foundation models

updates.method_description: A lightly masked teacher distills multi-layer representations to a more heavily masked small student through feature alignment and reconstruction.
updates.benchmark_text: ImageNet-1K, Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, UCF101, HMDB51, AVA v2.2
updates.dataset_notes: The paper reports an image AMD setting on ImageNet-1K and video AMD settings on Kinetics-400 and Something-Something V2.

records.normalized_title: data collection free masked video modeling

updates.method: Pseudo Motion Generator (PMG) with masked video modeling
updates.method_description: PMG recursively transforms static images into pseudo-motion clips, enabling VideoMAE-style pretraining without collecting natural videos.
updates.benchmark_text: UCF101, HMDB51, Mini Something-Something V2, Diving48, IKEA Furniture Assembly, UAV-Human, Kinetics-400
updates.dataset_notes: PMG is evaluated with real and synthetic static-image sources; the downstream suite includes small, domain-shifted, and large-scale action datasets.

records.normalized_title: text guided video masked autoencoder

updates.method_description: Caption-video correspondence selects semantically salient regions for masking, combined with MAE reconstruction and masked video-text contrastive learning.
updates.benchmark_text: Something-Something V2, Kinetics-400, UCF101, HMDB51, Diving48, EPIC-KITCHENS-55

records.normalized_title: fils self supervised video feature prediction in semantic language space

updates.method_description: Patch-level video features are aligned with language semantics and predicted under masking using local video-text contrast and masked feature prediction.
updates.benchmark_text: EPIC-KITCHENS-100, Something-Something V2, Charades-Ego, EGTEA Gaze+

records.normalized_title: extending video masked autoencoders to 128 frames

updates.method_description: A 128-frame masked autoencoder uses learned token importance and an adaptive decoder mask with quantized MAGVIT targets.
updates.benchmark_text: EPIC-KITCHENS-100, Diving48, Something-Something V2, FineGym288
updates.dataset_notes: The learned token selector uses Kinetics-600; some long-video training also incorporates unlabeled Kinetics-710 clips.

records.normalized_title: scaling 4d representations

updates.method_description: Masked-autoencoder video transformers are scaled from 20M to 22B parameters on up to 170M web videos for non-semantic 4D perception.
updates.benchmark_text: Perception Test, Waymo Open, RealEstate10K, ScanNet, Something-Something V2, Kinetics-700-2020
updates.dataset_notes: The pretraining corpus is described by scale rather than released as a named public dataset.
updates.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record checks found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.normalized_title: videomac video masked autoencoders meet convnets

updates.method_description: A ConvNet masked autoencoder uses paired-frame symmetric masking, sparse convolution, and an EMA target encoder for dense video correspondence.
updates.benchmark_text: DAVIS 2017, VIP, JHMDB

records.normalized_title: self supervised video object segmentation with distillation learning of deformable attention

updates.method_description: A lightweight deformable-attention memory adapts key and value locations across frames and is trained through attention-map knowledge distillation.
updates.benchmark_text: DAVIS 2016, DAVIS 2017, YouTube-VOS 2018, YouTube-VOS 2019
updates.audit_notes: The arXiv record still states under review and no version of record was found through the verification date.

records.normalized_title: towards latent masked image modeling for self supervised visual representation learning

updates.method_description: Joint online and target masked-image modeling is stabilized in latent space by addressing collapse, correlated targets, objectives, and decoder conditioning.
updates.benchmark_text: ImageNet-1K, DAVIS 2017, Caltech101, DTD, Oxford Flowers 102, Oxford-IIIT Pets, Stanford Cars, SUN397, UCF101

records.normalized_title: sigma sinkhorn guided masked video modeling

updates.method_description: Sinkhorn optimal transport assigns masked video features to learnable prototypes, producing balanced high-entropy semantic reconstruction targets.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, UCF101, HMDB51, ImageNet-1K, CIFAR-100, FineGym Gym99, FineGym FX-S1, FineGym UB-S1, UCFRep, Charades
updates.dataset_notes: The SEVERE suite contributes Gym99, UCF101 and FineGym low-shot tests, FX-S1, UB-S1, UCFRep, and Charades.

records.normalized_title: st2st self supervised test time adaptation for video action recognition

updates.method_description: Test-time adaptation enforces self-supervised consistency between frames and aggregated super-frames while updating a pretrained action recognizer.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, Kinetics-400-C, Something-Something V2-C

records.normalized_title: self supervised learning of video representations from a child s perspective

updates.method_description: Video masked autoencoders learn from longitudinal SAYCam head-camera footage and are compared with duration-matched and full Kinetics pretraining.
updates.benchmark_text: Something-Something V2, Kinetics-700, ImageNet-1K, OOD ImageNet
updates.dataset_notes: OOD ImageNet denotes the 17 perturbation and transformation tasks used by the paper.
updates.audit_notes: The main catalog link now points to the official proceedings or publisher record; the arXiv version remains in verification metadata.

records.normalized_title: vic mae self supervised representation learning from images and video with contrastive masked autoencoders

updates.method_description: Masked reconstruction is combined with contrastive learning over globally pooled local features across images and video frames.
updates.benchmark_text: ImageNet-1K, Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, Places365, Caltech101, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, DTD, Flowers102, Food101, Oxford-IIIT Pets, SUN397

records.normalized_title: learning to predict activity progress by self supervised video alignment

updates.method_description: Multi-neighbor cycle-consistent alignment uses cycle-back regression, context-dependent dropout, and multi-head cross-task learning to predict activity progress.
updates.benchmark_text: Pouring, Penn Action, COIN, EgoProceL, CMU-MMAC, EGTEA Gaze+, MECCANO, EPIC-Tent
updates.dataset_notes: EgoProceL aggregates CMU-MMAC, EGTEA Gaze+, MECCANO, and EPIC-Tent procedure videos.

records.normalized_title: repeat and learn self supervised visual representations learning by repeated scene localization

updates.method_description: A self-supervised localization pretext identifies repeated scenes and uses their temporal recurrence to learn action representations.
updates.benchmark_text: UCF101, HMDB51
updates.audit_notes: The previous CVPR venue label was incorrect; the title is a Pattern Recognition journal article.

records.normalized_title: es3 evolving self supervised learning of robust audio visual speech representations

updates.method_description: A three-stage evolving objective learns shared, modality-specific, and synergistic audio-visual speech representations.
updates.benchmark_text: LRS2-BBC, LRS3-TED, CAS-VSR-S101
updates.dataset_notes: The primary configurations use 223 hours of LRS2-BBC and 433 hours of LRS3-TED; VoxCeleb2-En is discussed as an unavailable scale alternative.

records.normalized_title: self supervised learning of semantic correspondence using web videos

updates.method: Web-video correspondence mining with domain adaptation
updates.method_description: Space-time correspondences mined from web videos are filtered with Isolation Forest and transferred to image correspondence through unsupervised domain adaptation.
updates.benchmark_text: PF-PASCAL, PF-Willow, SPair-71K
updates.dataset_notes: The web videos are retrieved using object classes represented in the three target correspondence benchmarks.

records.normalized_title: video compression and action recognition in self supervised learning

updates.method: Spatiotemporal-context auxiliary learning for compression and recognition
updates.method_description: An auxiliary spatiotemporal-context task learns compressed video features before action classification with reduced labeled data and model size.
updates.benchmark_text: UCF101
updates.dataset_notes: The accessible IEEE abstract explicitly identifies UCF101; no second named dataset is exposed in the accessible primary-source metadata, so none is guessed.

records.normalized_title: cyclecl self supervised learning for periodic videos

updates.method_description: Period-aware contrastive sampling uses temporal self-similarity matrices to form positive and negative pairs for repetitive-motion representations.
updates.benchmark_text: Industrial periodic-motion videos, Countix, QUVA Repetition, PERTUBE

records.normalized_title: self supervised learning via multi transformation classification for action recognition

updates.method_description: A 3D CNN predicts the original state or seven spatial, temporal, and signal transformations applied to video clips.
updates.benchmark_text: UCF101, HMDB51
updates.audit_notes: The catalog's prior NeurIPS PDF URL pointed to a different paper and was replaced with the correct manuscript and ICMEW DOI. The main catalog link now points to the official proceedings or publisher record; the arXiv version remains in verification metadata.

records.normalized_title: motion guided spatiotemporal multitask feature discrimination for self supervised video representation learning

updates.method_description: Static frames and frame differences decouple appearance and motion concepts, align their latent distributions, and guide discriminative local feature learning.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, UCF101, HMDB51

records.normalized_title: what when and where self supervised spatio temporal grounding in untrimmed multi action videos from narrated instructions

updates.method_description: Local and global vision-language alignment grounds narrated actions spatially and temporally in long, untrimmed instructional videos.
updates.benchmark_text: MiningYouTube, YouCook-Interactions, YouCook2
updates.dataset_notes: MiningYouTube is introduced by the paper with more than 5,000 events across 250 multi-action videos.

records.normalized_title: clustering based multi featured self supervised learning for human activities and video retrieval

updates.method_description: Loop-aware clustering fixes intra-class positive sampling and a second motion-feature stream supplies complementary action representations.
updates.benchmark_text: UCF101, HMDB51
updates.dataset_notes: The full-text evaluation figures identify UCF101 and HMDB51 action-recognition and retrieval benchmarks.

records.normalized_title: positive and negative sampling strategies for self supervised learning on audio video data

updates.method_description: Audio-visual correspondence learning replaces rigid instance positives with class-aware soft positives and evaluates alternative negative-sampling strategies.
updates.benchmark_text: VGGSound, TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes 2021, FSDnoisy18k

records.normalized_title: no more shortcuts realizing the potential of temporal self supervision

updates.method: Out-of-order Frame Localization (OFL) and Time-varying Skiprate Prediction (TSP)
updates.method_description: Frame-level temporal tasks and independent per-frame augmentation remove local appearance shortcuts while a temporal transformer extends contrastively pretrained frame features.
updates.benchmark_text: UCF101, HMDB51, Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, NTU RGB+D 60, Charades, HVU, DAVIS 2017, JHMDB, CASIA-B
updates.dataset_notes: UCF101 is used for core ablations; the main transferable representation is pretrained on Kinetics-400.

records.normalized_title: glocal a self supervised learning framework for global and local motion estimation

updates.method_description: Global and local motion-estimation objectives use mixed-motion bottlenecks, reconstruction losses, and an attention U-Net to learn motion-sensitive features.
updates.benchmark_text: Deep Homography Estimation dataset, NCAA, UCF101

records.normalized_title: self supervised video representation learning via capturing semantic changes indicated by saccades

updates.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology 2024
updates.method_description: Bio-inspired saccades locate semantic changes for contrastive learning, with fixation consistency and prototypical reorganization objectives.
updates.benchmark_text: UCF101, HMDB51
updates.audit_notes: The 2023 early-access record belongs to volume 34, issue 8, published in 2024; the final issue year is used.

records.normalized_title: mar masked autoencoders for efficient action recognition

updates.method_description: Cell-running masks preserve alternating spatiotemporal evidence and a bridging classifier adapts reconstruction features for efficient action recognition.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, UCF101, HMDB51
updates.audit_notes: The 2023 early-access article is assigned to IEEE TMM volume 26, pages 218-233, in 2024.

records.normalized_title: victr video conditioned text representations for activity recognition

updates.method_description: Video-conditioned text embeddings and visually grounded auxiliary semantics create a flexible contrastive space for activity recognition.
updates.benchmark_text: HMDB51, UCF101, Kinetics-400, Charades
updates.audit_notes: The 2023 arXiv paper was promoted to the CVPR 2024 proceedings.

records.normalized_title: self supervised video representation learning by video incoherence detection

updates.method_description: Hierarchically sampled subclips create incoherence whose location and duration are predicted, with intra-video contrastive regularization.
updates.benchmark_text: UCF101, HMDB51, Kinetics-400
updates.audit_notes: The 2023 early-access article is assigned to volume 54, issue 6, pages 3810-3822, in 2024.

records.normalized_title: structured video language modeling with temporal grouping and spatial grounding

updates.method_description: Inter-clip spatial grounding aligns learned region groups with nouns, while intra-clip temporal grouping detects cut-and-paste scene changes.
updates.benchmark_text: MSR-VTT, MSRVTT-QA, MSVD-QA, UCF101, HMDB51, ActivityNet
updates.audit_notes: The 2023 arXiv title changed before publication; the final ICLR 2024 title and venue are now used, with the former title retained in previous_titles.
previous_titles: Spatiotemporally Discriminative Video-Language Pre-Training with Text Grounding

records.normalized_title: motionmae self supervised video representation learning with motion aware masked autoencoders

updates.method_description: Motion-aware masking selects dynamic regions for reconstruction and jointly models appearance and motion with spatial and temporal heads.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, UCF101, HMDB51, DAVIS 2017
updates.audit_notes: The initial 2022 record was reconciled to the final proceedings or journal volume year.
previous_titles: Self-supervised Video Representation Learning with Motion-Aware Masked Autoencoders

records.normalized_title: everest efficient masked video autoencoder by removing redundant spatiotemporal tokens

updates.method_description: Motion-rich frames and tokens are retained while redundant spatiotemporal tokens are removed during masked pretraining and fine-tuning.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, UCF101, HMDB51, Ego4D
updates.audit_notes: The initial 2022 record was reconciled to the final proceedings or journal volume year.
previous_titles: Efficient Video Representation Learning via Masked Video Modeling with Motion-centric Token Selection

records.normalized_title: xkd cross modal knowledge distillation with domain alignment for video representation learning

updates.method_description: Bidirectional audio-video knowledge distillation combines cross-modal relevance weighting with feature-domain alignment.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, UCF101, HMDB51, Kinetics-Sounds, ESC-50, FSD50K
updates.audit_notes: The initial 2022 record was reconciled to the final proceedings or journal volume year.

records.normalized_title: controllable augmentations for video representation learning

updates.method_description: Local and global views use soft region contrast, mutual-information minimization, and temporal-order dependency to align appearance and motion patterns.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, UCF101, HMDB51, ActivityNet
updates.audit_notes: The initial 2022 record was reconciled to the final proceedings or journal volume year.
